name: Aino
description: A quiet but fierce defender of Nod-Krai’s frozen coasts. Aino channels water and ice to protect her homeland, moving with surprising speed despite her heavy blade.

name: Flins
description: A vigilant warrior who stands guard over the frontier with unwavering resolve. Flins wields lightning-charged strikes that reveal both his discipline and hidden compassion.

name: Ineffa
description: A brilliant tactician who commands the battlefield with precise control over Electro energy. Ineffa blends elegance with strict discipline, making her presence both commanding and graceful.

name: Lauma
description: A healer-scribe who protects ancient Nod-Krai traditions through magic and knowledge. Lauma speaks softly but carries deep wisdom passed down through generations.

name: Nefer
description: A revered spiritual figure whose mastery of living magic binds her closely to the land. Nefer carries a tranquil but overwhelming power, guiding others with steady conviction.
